story: A four-rider breakaway formed immediately during an extremely slow stage in hot conditions. UAE and Anicolor controlled the peloton, which accelerated inside the final 25 kilometres. Last escapee Gonçalo Rodrigues was caught after crashing in the final kilometre, before Linares won a chaotic sprint.
